basic_info.description: Newly renovated home in best Noe Valley location on a tree lined block near Sanchez slow street and 24th Street shopping district. Modern finishes. Open bi-level floor plan with 3BR/2BA and a shared backyard and roof deck with big views. Lower level family room/den + master en-suite. Wood floors. In unit washer/dryer. Walk to Noe Cafe, Angela's Ice Cream, Saru Sushi, La Boulangerie, Whole Foods, Fiorella, Dubliner. Half a block from J-Church and pubic transportation.
